title: 6 lab tests: can you guess all 6?

end.cta: Subscribe: you pick the next test

description: Six tests from the lab, back to back: make your bet before each slow motion, then count your score.
Every number on screen comes from a published test or a physics law; the source is shown at the end of each test. The scenes are 3D simulations built on those numbers.
_cut: each episode is kept from 0 to its call to action (explain end + 1.4 s): hook, rounds, slow motion, WHY and source card stay, the next-test promise and the CTA go. end_s was computed from the episode's timeline rebuilt at its render commit (render_run).
